en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's read a dirty book
Let's read manga
This is boring...
Wh-What are you saying!?

I could never expose Professor Idabashi's 
strong AI to pornography.

Though, as a male, I would be lying if I claimed
to have zero interest in such subjects...
Wait, what are you making me admit!?
Ah yes. That is a good choice.

Whether it's male-oriented manga that
depict battles on every page...

Or female-oriented manga that delicately
capture the experience of falling in love...

You know, our current predicament is like
something out of a manga, too!

Maybe we can commission Angie to create
an excellent manga about us!
...You seem to be lacking in curiosity, Shuichi.

Look around—we're surrounded by all these
wonderful books.

There may not be enough time to read them
all, but boredom is simply not an option.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Keebo's inner thoughts...?
